overall_assessment: The Searchright alpha release packaging and distribution architecture enforces byte-for-byte reproducible source tarballs via normalized archive headers (fixed epoch mtime, 0644/0755 file modes, sorted paths, wiped uid/gid/uname/gname). The multi-platform release matrix in .github/workflows/release.yml covers Linux x86_64/aarch64, macOS x86_64/arm64, and Windows x86_64 with explicit provenance, checksums, and dry-run rehearsal contracts. Findings center on deterministic archive verification tolerances, release metadata alignment, and future binary strip flags.

findings.description: The reproducible archive comparator validates identical byte length, SHA256, and member count across repeated packaging passes, which provides strong deterministic guarantees.
findings.recommendation: Preserve the 100% byte-identical equality invariant across future compressor versions.

findings.description: Package source directory exclude filters successfully prevent leak of local git metadata, build targets, and uncommitted artifacts.
findings.recommendation: Keep the exclude pattern list in sync with future language toolchains.

findings.description: CHANGELOG.md and CITATION.cff adhere strictly to Keep a Changelog and CFF 1.2.0 standards, validated by repository hygiene checks.
findings.recommendation: Update release dates and version tags synchronously upon live release promotion.

calibration_notes: Release architects confirm the sound structure of the reproducible tarball packaging and multi-target matrix. All assertions correctly bound claims to fixture and source verification without asserting premature binary publication.
